- Material: smooth, seamless glossy emerald body with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat and small: his whole coil is only about 15 percent of the person's height, about as tall as the agent's knee and clearly less than half the agent's height; a slim tube, not a thick one.
- Outfit: none; he is the pet, not a mascot.
- Expression: content, eyes half-closed in the warm sun.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single round "O" resting flat on the wide pale concrete front step just outside the threshold, in a patch of sunlight, the ring open at the top right: his head rests over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip rises just to the right of his head. Belly on the inner curve, a soft shadow under the coil on the step.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view toward the camera, turned a little toward the agent, eyes half-closed.

## Props
- Glass door: a tall frameless glass pivot door in a slim dark-bronze frame, swung open inward toward the left, its two hinge pivots clearly drawn at the top and bottom of its frame.
- Home: a clean, low modern beach house of pale cedar boards and smooth white render, a wide flat roof edge, a tall plain glass window to the left of the door with a potted olive tree in a white pot beside it, and a slim cylindrical matte-white wall light on a round backplate beside the door, unlit by day.
- Front step: one wide, smooth pale concrete step in front of the threshold, seen square-on.
- Deck: a wide, level deck of weathered pale timber boards running across the picture in front of the house, seen square-on, its boards parallel to the front edge, ending in a plain straight edge with the dunes beyond.
- Post: one stout square pale timber post with a flat square cap, rising to the agent's chest from the deck's edge at the right, drawn complete from the deck to its cap.
- Backpack: sand-coloured canvas, on the agent, with its two straps clearly drawn over the shoulders.

## Setting
A modern beach house on the coastal dunes at sunrise: a clear horizon with a calm, bright sea, soft pale sand dunes with silvery marram grass beyond the deck's edge, a pale beach and a low headland on the far right, a clear sky of soft blue and pale peach. A light sea breeze from the right lifts the agent's scarf toward the left. Keep the dunes simple and soft.

## Light
This is a bright, clear early-morning DAY picture, never night, dusk or twilight: the whole sky is bright daylight blue with a soft pale peach glow near the horizon, and there is no moon. Low, clear sunrise from the right with the sun itself out of frame beyond the right edge: a gentle warm key light on every figure's right side and soft, even daylight elsewhere. Shadows are few and soft-edged: a soft contact shadow under the person's feet, the agent's feet, the post and Ouro; no sunbeams, no light shafts, no stripes or bands of sunlight on the deck or walls; the deck and walls are evenly lit. The bright sky fills the scene with clean, luminous daylight. The person's warm inner light glows softly through the glass head.

## Palette
Clear soft blue and pale peach sky, bright sea blue, pale sand, silvery dune green, pale cedar and white render, oatmeal and light grey; emerald for Ouro; sea blue and coral for the agent. No amber, no dark wood, no stone cottage.

## Must not
- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No separate fingers on any hand: mitten hands, exactly one thumb, never separate fingers; no pointing, no waving, no thumbs-up.
- No hand of the person showing: both stay in the pockets; no skin at the pockets.
- No second hand on the agent: its far arm stays hidden behind its body.
- No rope rail, no railing and no boardwalk receding into the distance.
- No stretched, tall-and-thin or stick-figure person; no green, mint, milky or coloured-balloon person; no face and no ears on the person.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols.
- No emoji faces on visors: no ">" or "<" eyes, no tongues, no winks, no mouths, no grins, no curved line under the eyes.
- No comic or cartoon styling: no outlines, no exaggerated squash and stretch.
- No glowing trails, motion lines or lines of light.
- No phones, laptops, monitors or screens.
- No tiles, cells or facets on the glass bodies.
- No rustic, cottage, hobbit-hole or storybook house: no round door, no stone doorway, no thatch, no dark wood, no amber light.
- No moon, no stars, no night and no dusk; no sun in the frame, no sunbeams, no lens flare.
- No figure facing the camera full on.
- No giant Ouro: he is never taller than the agent's knee.
- No image fades or vignettes.

In a bright contemporary home kitchen on a sunny morning, one small robot holds up a plain blank recipe card and reads it aloud while a second small robot beside it whisks a bowl of batter, following the card, and Ouro, curled on a folded tea towel at the island's end, watches them.

## Camera
40 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. Eye level: a little above the kitchen island's top, as if we stand a few steps in front of the island. One vanishing point, just right of centre on the big window in the far wall, where the island's long edges, the oak floor boards and the shelf lines converge.

- What: a small robot agent reading the skill aloud from a recipe card.

- Outfit: a navy linen apron tied at the waist, and a short pencil tucked behind its ear disc.
- Expression: focused and earnest: on its visor, two soft glowing oval eyes, gently arched, looking down at the card; no mouth.
- Pose: standing on the island top left of the bowl, both feet flat on the stone and fully visible, holding the card up at chest height in front of it, tilted toward the cook.

### The cook
- What: a small robot agent putting the skill into practice by whisking batter.

- What: Ouro, the pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.

- Outfit: none; he is the pet, not a mascot.
- Expression: curious and pleased: eyes open and soft, watching the whisk in the bowl, a small smile.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single round "O" resting on a folded pale linen tea towel on the island's right end, the ring open at the top right: his head rests over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip rises just to the right of his head. Belly on the inner curve, a soft shadow under the coil on the towel.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view, turned toward the robots and the bowl.

## Props
- Island: one long kitchen island with a thick pale honed limestone top with softly rounded edges and a plain pale oak base, running across the middle of the frame.
- Recipe card: one plain cream-white card, about the size of the reader's chest, completely blank on both sides.
- Bowl: one wide white ceramic mixing bowl of pale golden batter on the island top between the robots.
- Whisk: one steel balloon whisk, its handle in the cook's near mitten, its wires in the batter.

- Tea towel: one folded pale linen tea towel under Ouro.

A bright contemporary home kitchen on a clear spring morning: white walls, a pale oak floor, a big steel-framed window across the far wall looking onto a sunny green garden with shrubs and a young tree, a pale limestone counter with a simple steel sink under the window, three open oak shelves on the left wall, and a tall olive tree in a white planter at the right. - No image fades or vignettes.

# Friends relay: carrying messages between friends' agents

## Story
On a sleek modern footbridge of pale timber and steel over a calm city canal on a bright morning, two small robots, each come from its own end of the bridge, meet in the middle and hand a sealed cream envelope from one to the other, the receiver tipping its cap in hello, while Ouro, cat-sized in a little postman's cap, watches from the bridge deck beside them.

## Camera
40 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. Eye level: the bridge's handrail, as if we stand on the next low bridge a little way down the canal. The bridge crosses the frame from left to right, square to the camera. One vanishing point, at the centre of the frame just above the handrail, where the canal's two stone-edged banks, the rows of canal-side buildings and the water's reflections converge, far beyond the bridge.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024; the chosen picture is widened on both sides and shipped as an 8:3 strip; the crop band is the whole height, so the two robots, the envelope between their hands and Ouro sit together in the middle half of the width, on the bridge deck at the middle of the bridge. Safe area: the left quarter is the bridge running on to the left bank, with a young tree in a planter on the bank and pale modern buildings behind; the right quarter is the bridge running on to the right bank, with more trees and buildings. The envelope is at the exact centre, between the robots, clear against the open sky and the far canal. Nothing important in the top or bottom fifth of the frame: the top fifth is clear morning sky, the bottom fifth is calm canal water under the bridge.

## Cast

### The courier robot
- What: a small robot agent delivering a message from its friend's side of the canal.
- Material: smooth, seamless soft pearl-white glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor, a round satin-brass ear disc and a tiny antenna with a pearl bead.
- Height: standing on the deck, its head reaches just above the bridge's handrail.
- Outfit: a navy courier cap and a small tan canvas satchel on a strap across its chest.
- Expression: proud and careful: on its visor, two soft glowing round eyes, gently arched, looking at the envelope; no mouth.
- Pose: standing on the bridge deck just left of centre, having walked in from the left end, leaning a little forward, both feet flat on the deck and fully visible through the glass balustrade.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: round mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. Near (right) mitten: holding the left end of the envelope, thumb on top. Far (left) mitten: resting closed on the satchel's flap.
- Facing: body in profile turned to the right of frame, toward the other robot, head and visor three-quarters toward the camera so both eyes read.

### The friend's robot
- What: a small robot agent receiving the message for its own person on the other side.
- Material: smooth, seamless soft coral glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor, a round satin-brass ear disc and a tiny antenna with a coral bead.
- Height: the same height as the courier robot.
- Outfit: a soft grey knitted scarf and a small charcoal flat cap.
- Expression: delighted: on its visor, two soft glowing curved eyes lifted toward the courier robot; no mouth; it rises a little onto its toes.
- Pose: standing on the bridge deck just right of centre, having walked in from the right end, both feet flat on the deck and fully visible through the glass balustrade.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: round mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. Near (left) mitten: holding the right end of the envelope, thumb on top. Far (right) mitten: closed on the brim of its flat cap, tipping the cap in hello.
- Facing: body in profile turned to the left of frame, toward the courier robot, head and visor three-quarters toward the camera so both eyes read.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless glossy emerald body with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat; his whole coil is about as tall as a robot's head, much smaller than the robots.
- Outfit: a tiny navy postman's cap with a short peak, sitting snugly on top of his head, with no badge.
- Expression: curious and pleased: eyes open and soft, watching the envelope, a small smile.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single round "O" resting on the bridge deck just in front of the robots' feet, a little right of centre, inside the glass balustrade, the ring open at the top right: his head rests over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip rises just to the right of his head. Belly on the inner curve, a soft shadow under the coil on the deck.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view, turned up toward the envelope.

## Props
- Envelope: one plain sealed cream paper envelope, held flat and level between the two robots' near mittens at the centre, with one small round green wax seal with no mark.
- Bridge: a sleek modern pedestrian footbridge with a flat deck of pale timber boards on one slim pale steel beam, a frameless clear glass balustrade on both sides and one continuous pale timber handrail along the top of each glass balustrade.
- Satchel: a small tan canvas satchel with a flap, on the courier robot.
- Caps: the courier robot's navy cap, the friend's robot's charcoal flat cap and Ouro's tiny navy postman's cap.

## Setting
A calm city canal on a clear morning: still blue-green water with soft reflections, clean pale stone canal edges, rows of contemporary canal-side buildings of pale brick, white render and tall glass running away along both banks, young trees in leaf along the water, a few moored small white boats far down the canal, a few slim modern street lamps along the far banks, and a clear sky with a few soft clouds. The air is still.

## Light
Bright, clean morning sunlight from the right and slightly behind the bridge is the key light, with soft rim light on every figure and the bridge. Soft white daylight fills the whole scene, so it reads clean and luminous. A soft contact shadow sits under each robot's feet and under Ouro on the deck, and the bridge casts a long soft shadow on the water below. The robots' glass bodies glow softly from within.

## Palette
Clean white, pale timber and pale stone, soft sky blue and canal blue-green, leaf green; pearl white and navy for the courier robot; coral and grey for the friend's robot; emerald for Ouro; cream for the envelope. No amber, no dark wood.

- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No separate fingers on any hand: mitten hands, exactly one thumb, never separate fingers; no pointing gesture and no thumbs-up.
- No people in the picture.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols: the envelope, the seal, the satchel, the caps, the boats and the buildings are blank.
- No emoji faces on visors: no ">" or "<" eyes, no tongues, no winks, no mouths, no grins, no curved line under the eyes.
- No comic or cartoon styling: no outlines, no exaggerated squash and stretch.
- No glowing trails, motion lines, dotted paths or lines of light.
- No birds, doves, towers, dovecotes or drones.
- No phones, laptops, monitors or screens.
- No tiles, cells or facets on the glass bodies.
- No rustic or storybook look: no cottages, no cartoon meadows, no old stone bridge, no dark wood, no amber light.
- No figure facing the camera full on.
- No giant Ouro: he is never taller than a robot's head.
- No image fades or vignettes.

## Output
Generated whole at 1536x1024, quality high. The chosen picture is widened on both sides and shipped as a 1536x576 header and as phone and social crops centred on the cast. The night twin is a relight of the chosen picture: the same frame, figures and poses in the evening by the canal-side windows and lamps and moonlight.

1. The first image: the current ouroboros.bot airship master's centre, for the render quality, light, materials and the look of the agents only. Its airship, setting and composition are not to be copied.
2. The second image: `brand/ouro.png`, for Ouro's exact face and coil.

generation.prompt:
# Labs: forks and experiments

## Story
In a bright, warm modern lab, a small robot stands behind a long low worktable, hands behind its back, proudly looking over the white model plane it has just built, while its person stands at the table's left end with both hands in their pockets, admiring it too, and Ouro, their pet snake, watches from a folded cloth on the table's right end.

## Camera
40 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. Eye level: just a little above the worktable's top, as if we sit on a low stool a few steps in front of the table, so the tabletop shows only as a thin, shallow sliver of its top surface above its front edge. The worktable is seen square-on: its long front edge runs straight across the frame, parallel to the bottom of the picture. One vanishing point, at the centre of the picture on that eye level, where the floor's joints and the top edges of the table's two short ends converge. The table's base is closed, so no table legs show. The back wall is flat and parallel to the picture, and the line where the floor meets the back wall runs straight across the frame.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024; the chosen picture is widened on both sides to an 8:3 strip, so the crop band is the whole height, and the cast sits close together at the worktable across the middle half of the width and fills most of its height. Left to right: the person standing just left of the table's left end, the robot behind the middle of the table with the model plane in front of it, Ouro on his folded cloth at the table's right end. Safe area: the left quarter is the white back wall with a pegboard of finished model planes and a tall plant; the right quarter is the back wall's tall window with soft daylight and a second plant. Nothing important in the top or bottom fifth of the frame.

## Cast

### The person
- What: a faceless adult person from the shared universe, the robot's person, watching it work.
- Material: a matte frosted glass head and neck, like softly sandblasted glass, with a soft, even warm inner light, warm white turning soft gold at the core and no glossy highlights; the head reads as one soft, opaque-looking frosted form with nothing visible inside it; a real adult head: a slightly elongated oval skull, a clear jaw line and a natural neck about four tenths of the head's width joining the shoulders; no ears; no face at all: no eyes, nose, brow, mouth or smile; never a clear bubble or bulb, never milky white or saturated green.
- Build: natural adult proportions and an ordinary build: real shoulders, a head about one-seventh of the standing height or a little less, never larger, a normal torso, arms and legs of natural length and thickness; never stretched tall and thin, never toy-like.
- Height: the tallest figure; the worktable's top is at the person's hip.
- Outfit: a soft oatmeal knit jumper with a wide, low round neckline, so the whole neck shows between the jaw and the collar, and long sleeves down to the wrists; dark charcoal trousers with clearly drawn front pockets; clean white sneakers.
- Expression: faceless; quiet, pleased interest shown by the body: head tilted down a little toward the model plane, shoulders relaxed.
- Pose: standing on the floor just left of the table's left end, both sneakers flat on the floor and fully visible, weight on one leg.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs.
- Hands: smooth glass mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers; both hands are pushed deep into the front pockets of the trousers, so no hand and no skin shows: each jumper sleeve ends with its knit cuff going straight into a clearly drawn dark pocket opening.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned to the right of frame toward the robot; head turned toward the model plane.

### The robot
- What: a small robot agent building a model plane.
- Material: smooth, seamless soft apricot glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor and a tiny brass antenna with an apricot bead.
- Height: standing on the floor behind the table, the top of its head reaches the person's shoulder; the tabletop is at its waist.
- Outfit: a short white lab coat with the sleeves rolled to the elbow.
- Expression: proud: on its visor, two soft glowing oval eyes lowered toward the model plane; no mouth and no line, curve, reflection or highlight under the eyes; the visor below the eyes is a plain dark gradient.
- Pose: standing behind the middle of the table, chest a little forward, both arms behind its back.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs; its legs are hidden behind the table.
- Hands: round mittens, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers; both arms are folded behind its back with the mittens clasped out of sight behind its body: only the upper arms and the rolled white sleeves show at its sides, bending back behind it.
- Facing: body square to the camera, head tilted down toward the plane so both eyes read.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless glossy emerald body with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat; his whole coil is about as tall as the robot's head, much smaller than the robot.
- Outfit: none; he is the pet, not a mascot.
- Expression: curious and pleased: eyes wide open, round and soft as in the second reference image, looking at the model plane, a small smile.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single round "O" resting on a folded pale grey cloth on the tabletop's right end, the ring open at the top right: his head rests over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip rises just to the right of his head. Belly on the inner curve, a soft shadow under the coil on the cloth.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view toward the camera.

## Props
- Worktable: one long, low worktable seen square-on: a thin pale birch top on a closed pale birch base, a plain front panel running the table's full length down to a slim plinth on the floor, so no legs show; its top is shallow from front to back, and its two short ends are plain birch panels, clear of the figures.
- Model plane: one white balsa-and-paper model plane, wider than the robot's shoulders, resting level on a small birch stand on the tabletop in front of the robot, its nose pointing to the right, its wingtips clear of the robot's arms; plain white with no marks or stripes.
- On the table: a small cutting mat, a few plain balsa strips and a tidy pot of pencils, all lying or standing on the tabletop.
- Pegboard: a white pegboard panel on the back wall at the left, set in a thin pale birch frame that is fixed to the wall by four round brass screw caps, one at each corner; two finished plain white model planes rest level on it, each lying across a pair of short brass pegs under its wings, the pegs clearly drawn and touching both the board and the plane.
- Pendant lamps: two simple white dome pendant lamps hanging over the table, each on a straight black cord that runs up out of the top of the picture; each dome has a visible pale bulb inside; unlit by day.
- Plants: a tall leafy plant in a white pot at the left, and another at the right.
- Cloth: a folded pale grey cloth under Ouro.

## Setting
A bright, warm modern lab: a flat white back wall, a pale polished concrete floor with a few straight joints receding to the vanishing point, a tall plain window in the back wall at the right with soft pale sky and soft distant green shapes through it, two plants and a little lived-in clutter on the table. The air is still.

## Light
Soft, warm late-morning daylight from the left, with the sun itself out of frame: a gentle warm key light on every figure's left side and soft, even daylight everywhere else. Shadows are few and soft-edged: a soft contact shadow under the table's legs, the person's sneakers, the model plane's stand and Ouro; no sunbeams, no light shafts, no window-bar stripes and no patches or bands of sunlight on the floor or walls; the floor and walls are evenly lit. The person's warm inner light glows softly through the glass head.

## Palette
Warm white, pale birch and pale concrete, soft sky blue and leaf green, oatmeal and charcoal; apricot and white for the robot; emerald for Ouro; small touches of brass.

## Must not
- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No separate fingers on any hand: mitten hands, exactly one thumb, never separate fingers; no pointing, no waving, no thumbs-up.
- No hand of the person showing: both stay in the pockets; no skin at the pockets.
- No visible hand on the robot: both stay behind its back; no hand on the table or the model plane.
- No deep tabletop: the tabletop is a thin sliver seen from just above.
- No table legs and no robot legs showing.
- No stretched, tall-and-thin or stick-figure person; no green, mint, milky or coloured-balloon person; no face and no ears on the person.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols: every paper, plane and box is blank.
- No emoji faces on visors: no ">" or "<" eyes, no tongues, no winks, no mouths, no grins, no curved line under the eyes.

# Workshop: a small agent shows its person a plan

## Story
On a bright, modern mountain-view terrace in the golden light of late afternoon, a small robot agent holds up a large blank plan card tied with a green satin ribbon, offering it to its person, who listens with a calm, approving turn of the head, hands tucked into the pockets of a long open cardigan, while Ouro rests beside a big emerald dome on the low oak plinth between them.

## Camera
40 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. Eye level at the person's chest, as if we stand a few steps in front of the plinth. The pale oak deck boards run left to right, parallel to the frame, so the deck shows one clear floor line and no converging lines; the plinth is seen square-on, its front face parallel to the frame, and its top shows only as a thin strip below eye level. One horizon line, level with the person's chest, across the far mountains.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024; the chosen picture is widened on both sides and shipped as an 8:3 strip; the crop band is the whole height, so the person, the plinth with the agent, the dome and Ouro, and the floor lamp sit together in the middle half of the width. Safe area: the left quarter is the open terrace with a slim tall floor lamp and a quiet corner of the pale glass balustrade; the right quarter is a large pale planter with a big green fern and the open sky. Nothing important in the top or bottom fifth of the frame.

## Cast

### The agent
- What: Loop, a small mint-green robot agent showing its plan.
- Material: smooth, seamless soft mint glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor, round satin-brass ear discs and a tiny antenna with a mint bead.
- Height: standing on the plinth top, its head reaches the standing person's hip.
- Outfit: a small soft cream apron-vest over its body.
- Expression: proud and hopeful: on its visor, two soft glowing round eyes held level and lifted toward the person; no mouth, nothing under the eyes.
- Pose: standing on the plinth's top at its middle, feet flat and fully visible, holding the blank plan card up in front of its chest with both mittens.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: large round mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers, each no wider than its brass cuff. Both mittens hold the plan card's two lower side edges from the sides, and each mitten shows one clearly visible thumb pointing up along the card's face, so every hand reads as a mitten plus one thumb.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned to the left of frame toward the person; head lifted toward the person so both eyes read.

### The person
- What: a faceless adult person from the shared universe, listening.
- Material: smooth, seamless, lightly frosted glass head, neck and hands, with a soft warm inner light, warm white turning soft gold at a brass-to-emerald core in the chest; a real adult head with skull, a clear, defined jaw line, a slender neck only about four tenths of the head's width (clearly narrower than the head and the shoulders), and no face at all: no eyes, nose, brow, mouth or smile, and smooth bare sides of the head with no ears; never milky or saturated green.
- Build: natural adult proportions and an ordinary build: real shoulders, a head about one-seventh of the body height, a normal torso, arms and legs of natural length and thickness; never stretched tall and thin, never toy-like or balloon-like.
- Height: the tallest figure; the plinth top is at the person's knee.
- Outfit: a long open cream knit cardigan with two large patch pockets, a soft grey shirt, dark grey trousers and clean white sneakers.
- Expression: faceless; calm approval shown by the body: head turned in three-quarter view toward the agent so the jaw line reads, shoulders relaxed.
- Pose: standing on the deck at the plinth's left end, weight on one leg, both sneakers flat on the deck.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs.
- Hands: both hands are in the two cardigan pockets; each sleeve ends in a visible knit cuff that enters the clear, drawn opening of its large patch pocket, and no fingers are drawn.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, head turned three-quarters toward the agent on the right of frame.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless glossy emerald body with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat; his whole coil is only about a third of the agent's height, no taller than the agent's chest, clearly much smaller than the agent.
- Outfit: none; he is the pet, not a mascot.
- Expression: curious and pleased: eyes open and soft, a small smile.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single round "O" resting on the plinth's top at its right end, the ring open at the top right: his head rests over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip rises just to the right of his head. Belly on the inner curve, a soft shadow under the coil on the oak.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view, turned toward the agent.

## Props
- Plinth: one wide, low, clean pale oak plinth with a flat top and a plain square front face, matte black steel corner bands, seen square-on, standing on the deck at the middle of the frame.
- Dome: one large smooth emerald glass dome on a thin brass base, as wide as a dinner plate, resting on the plinth's top at the left of the agent; nobody touches it.
- Plan card: a large plain cream card with rounded corners and a green satin ribbon tied in a bow across its top edge; the card is blank, with no lines, ticks or marks.
- Floor lamp: one slim, tall floor lamp with a round matte black base, a thin black stem and a tall cylinder of warm opal glass, standing on the deck at the left; it is on, with a soft warm glow.
- Planter: one large pale concrete planter holding a big, soft, full green fern, at the right edge.
- Balustrade: a clean frameless glass balustrade with a slim pale oak cap rail, running across the terrace behind everyone, held by slim black steel posts; its far ends leave the frame.

## Setting
A bright, contemporary mountain-view terrace in a modern home: wide pale oak deck boards running left to right, a clean frameless glass balustrade, and beyond it a quiet, simple view of soft blue layered mountains under a sky of long, soft, high clouds. The air is still and clean. The sun itself is out of frame.

## Light
Warm, low, golden late-afternoon light from the right, from out of frame, with soft-edged shadows falling gently to the left and rim light on every figure; the high clouds glow soft gold and pink. Soft clean daylight fills the terrace so it reads luminous. A soft contact shadow sits under the plinth, the floor lamp, the planter, the person's sneakers, the agent's feet and Ouro. The person's warm inner light glows softly through the glass head and hands, and the floor lamp glows softly.

## Palette
Clean white, pale oak, pale concrete, soft sky blue and misty blue-grey mountains, leaf green and emerald; cream and soft grey for the person's clothes; mint and brass for the agent; emerald for Ouro and the dome. No amber, no dark wood.

## Must not
- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No separate fingers on any hand: mitten hands, exactly one thumb, never separate fingers; no pointing gesture, no waving and no thumbs-up.
- No stretched, tall-and-thin or stick-figure person; no green, mint, milky or coloured-balloon person; no face on the person; no ears on the person.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols: the card, the lamp and everything else are blank.
- No emoji faces on visors: no ">" or "<" eyes, no tongues, no winks, no mouths, no grins, no curved line under the eyes.
- No comic or cartoon styling: no outlines, no exaggerated squash and stretch.
- No glowing trails, motion lines or lines of light.
- No phones, laptops, monitors or screens.
- No tiles, cells or facets on the glass bodies.
- No rustic or storybook look: no log cabin, no dark wood, no amber light, no lantern on a hook, no cottage, no cartoon meadow.
- No figure facing the camera full on.
- No giant Ouro: he is never taller than the agent's head.
- No sun in the frame; no hanging objects.
- No image fades or vignettes.

## Output
Generated whole at 1536x1024, quality high. The chosen picture is widened on both sides and shipped as a 1536x576 header and as phone and social crops centred on the cast. The night twin is a relight of the chosen picture: the same frame, figures and poses under a deep night sky with a bright moon and moonlit clouds, with the floor lamp glowing.

generation.prompt:
Relight this picture as the same moment deep in the night, around midnight, with the room's ceiling lights off. The wide picture band in the middle is the picture; the flat grey bars above and below it are empty canvas: paint them as more of the studio's ceiling above and more oak floor below, continuing the picture seamlessly. Keep the same frame, composition, camera, every figure, pose, object and its position exactly as they are: the small periwinkle glass robot in its slate-grey apron standing behind the low white-oak desk, its two mittens resting on the ends of the open card box of blank white index cards; Ouro, the small green snake, asleep as one open ring on the low stack of slate-grey folders; the slim white desk lamp at the desk's right end; the wall of flush oak drawers with their small round knobs; the fiddle-leaf fig in its stone pot; the wide window with its slim white frames and the harbour beyond. Change only the light.
The only light in the room is the slim white desk lamp, switched on: the underside of its flat round head glows bright warm white, and it throws one strong, round, golden-warm pool of light down onto the desk top: the folders, Ouro and the right half of the card box are brightly and warmly lit, the robot's mittens, apron and visor catch warm light from the right, and the light fades smoothly into darkness before the desk's left end and down the desk's front panel. Everything outside that pool is dark night: the drawer wall, the fig, the floor and the left of the room sink into deep, dim, cool blue-grey shadow, still faintly readable, never pure black. The robot's two oval visor eyes glow softly.
The sun is gone: no daylight anywhere, no sunbeams, no light patches on the floor, no sharp shadows. Through the window: a very dark, deep navy-black night sky, darkest at the top, with many small faint stars; no moon in view; the calm water far below is almost black, with only a few faint dim reflections; the far shore and hills are black silhouettes, and the few distant buildings on the shore show a handful of tiny warm lit windows (single small dots). The window glass is darker than the lamp-lit desk; only faint cool starlight comes in, so the floor in front of the window stays dark. No text, letters or numbers. No new objects.

# Glue-unstuck: the person who used to be the glue takes a break

## Story
On a calm, bright late morning in a clean modern office courtyard, the person who used to hold everything together finally sits back on a low bench with a mug of tea in both hands, while Ouro, resting on a neat tray of sorted envelopes on a small cart by an open door, quietly takes care of the work.

## Camera
40 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. The camera is low and close, as if we sit on a low stool a few steps in front of the bench. Eye level: at the seated person's chest height, a little below the middle of the frame. The bench, the cart, the back wall, its doors and its windows are all square to the camera, their edges level and upright. One vanishing point, at the centre of the frame at that eye level, where the courtyard's paving joints converge; nothing else recedes. Everything above eye level is seen straight on or from slightly below: no top face of anything above eye level shows.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024; the chosen picture is widened on both sides and shipped as an 8:3 strip; the crop band is the whole height, so the person, the bench, the cart and Ouro sit together in the middle third of the frame. The bench is short and low, a little left of centre, about a quarter of the frame's width; the person sits on it, seen whole. The cart stands just right of the bench, beside an open glass door. Behind them, one long back wall runs straight across the frame: a warm white plaster wall with three tall glass doors and two tall windows, all square to the camera, their bottoms on the courtyard floor and their tops cut off by the top edge of the frame. Safe area: the left quarter is the wall, a wall lantern and a tall olive tree in a square pot; the right quarter is the wall, a window and a low planter of grasses. Nothing important in the top or bottom fifth of the frame.

## Cast

### The person
- What: one adult person, the only human figure.
- Material: lightly frosted, opaque-looking satin glass in a soft warm white with a gentle inner light; nothing visible inside the head or body.
- Height: a natural adult; seated, the top of the head is a little above the middle of the frame; the head is about one seventh of the standing height, with a slightly elongated oval skull, a clear jaw line and a slender neck about 0.4 of the head's width.
- Outfit: a soft sage-green knitted scarf loosely around the base of the neck, a relaxed oat-coloured knit sweater, slate trousers and plain dark shoes.
- Expression: faceless: no eyes, nose, brows, mouth or ears; the head tilts back a little, at ease.
- Pose: sitting upright but relaxed on the middle of the bench, back against its backrest, square to the camera; both forearms resting on the lap; both hands hold the mug together in front of the chest; the knees bent at a right angle, both feet flat on the paving side by side, each foot clearly its own.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs, each leg ending in its own shoe.
- Hands: mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. Each mitten is a slim rounded paddle no wider than its sweater cuff. Both mittens wrap the sides of one large mug, one on each side, thumbs on the front of the mug, both fully in view.
- Facing: body and head square to the camera.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the agent's pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless glossy emerald body with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat: his ring is about as tall as the seated person's head and neck together, far smaller than the person.
- Outfit: none.
- Expression: calm and busy: eyes open, looking down at the envelopes, a small content smile.
- Pose: one continuous body resting upright as a single open ring, like a capital letter "O" seen face-on, open at the top right, its lowest curve sitting on the tray of envelopes with a soft contact shadow; his head at the top of the ring, tipped forward toward the envelopes; one short tail tip resting on the tray. Never a spiral, a stack of coils or a flat coil.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: the ring faces the camera nearly square; head in three-quarter view toward the open door.

## Props
- Bench: one short, low bench of pale white oak, square to the camera: a flat seat with a slim slatted backrest, standing on two solid oak end panels that rest flat on the paving.
- Mug: one large plain matte white ceramic mug, held in both mittens, a thin curl of steam above it.
- Cart: one small low pale-oak cart on four small black wheels, square to the camera, standing on the paving just right of the bench; on its top, one shallow open tray of plain white envelopes, sorted upright in neat rows, with Ouro resting on top; on its lower shelf, two plain closed cardboard boxes.
- Doors and windows: three tall glass doors with slim black frames, the middle one standing open inward, showing a calm bright office inside: a plain pale wall and one round white pendant lamp hanging from the ceiling on a straight black rod. The other two doors are closed; the windows show soft reflections only.
- Wall lantern: one modern black metal wall lantern with frosted glass, fixed to the wall to the left of the doors on a short straight black bracket with a square wall plate; switched off by day.
- Plants: one tall olive tree in a square pale stone pot at the far left; one low planter of soft grasses at the far right.

## Setting
A clean modern office courtyard: pale stone paving in large square slabs whose joints run straight away from the camera; the back wall is warm white plaster, square to the camera, filling the frame from the paving to the top edge. No sky, no distant landscape, no roofs or chimneys in view.

## Light
Soft, bright, warm late-morning daylight, diffuse, coming from the upper left; the sun itself is out of frame and high, so there are no sun beams, stripes, window-shaped patches, leaf dapple or hard shadows on the paving or the wall. Soft contact shadows under the bench, the cart's wheels, the pots and the person's shoes. The person's glass glows softly; Ouro's scales catch a gentle highlight.

## Palette
Warm white plaster, pale stone, pale white oak, oat, sage green, slate, black metal, emerald, pale jade and soft olive green. No amber, no dark wood.

## Must not
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere: no writing on the envelopes, boxes, doors or mug.
- No separate fingers on any hand; no mitten wider than its cuff; no hand gripping a small object.
- No face and no ears on the person; no clear or bubble-shaped glass head.
- No sky, no mountains, no valley, no distant landscape, no roofs, no chimneys.
- No lamp without its holder: every lamp is fixed by a drawn bracket, rod or plate.
- No sun in the frame, no sun beams, no light stripes and no window-shaped patches of light.
- No second person, no robot, no second snake.
- No glowing trails or lines of light, no streaming papers.
- No comic or cartoon styling: no outlines, no exaggerated squash and stretch.
- No cottage, rustic or storybook look.
- No giant Ouro: his ring is never taller than the person's head and neck together.
- No image fades or vignettes.

## Output
Generated whole at 1536x1024, quality high. The chosen picture is widened on both sides and shipped as a 1536x576 header and as phone and social crops centred on the cast. The night twin is a light-only relight of the chosen picture: the same frame, figures and poses at night, lit by the wall lantern, the pendant lamp inside the open door and soft moonlight from the upper left.

## References
1. The first image: the current ouroboros.bot airship master's centre, for the render quality, light and materials only. Its airship, setting, people and composition are not to be copied.
2. The second image: `brand/ouro.png`, for Ouro's exact face and coil.

what: the realistic man is now a faceless glass person with mittens and a scarf, leaning back with his mug; the light trails, the papers they carried, and the glue bottle and stuck shoe are gone
the mailbox is plain; night is a real relight of the same frame, the cottages lit from inside
the card sky (skies/) is a fresh outpaint of the new header's sky
a pale heart-shaped mark under the counter and a round mark on the mailbox side are gone
edits.method: relit from the new day header by the GitHub Copilot CLI image_generation tool (same frame, light and sky only), registered back onto the day header's frame; then targeted edits as for the other scenes
why: no recognizable humans (agents/art-one-universe.md): people are the faceless glass figures with mittens, as in ouro-hx

Ari, 2026-11-15, on the glowing trail pasted through every scene: "that trail doesnt do anything at all" and, at 10:17, "i dont have something against glowing paths and such, it just became this weird thing that was in all the images even when it didnt make sense" / "dont overcorrect!" (agents/art-one-universe.md, .github#113): a trail stays where it is part of the scene and goes where it means nothing; the sparkle stays ("keep the sparkle! keep it all beautiful")
blind defect hunt (agents/art-one-universe.md, rule 4): fresh reviewers given only the picture and its 4x crops; every blocker they named is fixed

what: the night version of the same edit
edits.method: the 1536 px header, or a square crop of it upscaled to 1024 px, was edited by the GitHub Copilot CLI image_generation tool; each output was registered back onto the header (ECC affine or ORB similarity) and only the figure's region was pasted back, feathered, with the snake's own pixels masked out so Ouro keeps the previous header's pixels; a drawn robot mouth of a few pixels was inpainted (OpenCV Telea); everything else keeps the previous header's pixels
why: Art rule "expressive, never silly" (agents/art-one-universe.md, .github#150; Ari, 2026-11-15): people are clear or lightly frosted glass with a soft warm inner light and natural adult proportions, never a saturated colour or a balloon toy; robots show feeling through posture and eye shape, with no drawn mouth
blind defect hunt (agents/art-one-universe.md, rule 4): a fresh reviewer given only the picture and its 4x crops named nothing

generation.tool: GitHub Copilot CLI image_generation, 1536x1024, quality high
generation.prompt: (Excerpt; cast and style from brand/art/prompts/.) inside a cosy timber cabin studio on the hilltop at dawn ... one tall window of many small square panes in an oak grid ... a wide oak desk with one widescreen monitor showing soft green-and-cream cards ... Loop stands on the windowsill and swings one small pane open with both mittens on its brass handle ... the person sits at the desk and points with the whole mitten at the opening pane ... Ouro coiled in one round open O ... no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols; the window grid must not form a four-square logo

generation.what: the person's pointing hand redrawn as a mitten with a thumb, pointing at the story, not at a screen

Ouro moved from a figurine pose into the scene, lit by its light with a shadow: basking on the sill in the light through the opening pane
generation.method: a 1024x1024 cut of the 3:1 master edited by image_generation (brand/ouro.png as Ouro's reference), aligned and pasted back only where it changed, feathered

what: the monitor and keyboard are current (ultra-thin edge-to-edge screen, low-profile wireless keyboard, blank keys)

the night version of the same edits

why: Ari, 2026-11-15: "use either very modern devices, or vintage ones … make all art greenfield!" (agents/art-one-universe.md, devices rule)
blind defect hunt (agents/art-one-universe.md, rule 4): fresh reviewers given only the picture and its 4x crops; every blocker they named is fixed

what: the night version of the same edit

# Airship: ouroboros.bot home hero

## Story
Ari's agents sail his glass-and-brass airship above a sea of clouds in the early morning while he, faceless, stands calmly at the bow looking out, his pet snake Ouro on the rail beside him: one robot steers at the wheel, one climbs the rope ladder, one turns a brass valve.

## Camera
35 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. Eye level: about the person's shoulder, as if we stand on the stern step behind the cast. We look diagonally forward across the open deck toward the curved bow on the right. One vanishing point, on the horizon just right of centre, where the deck planks, the rail and the envelope's ribs all converge.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024 as the centre of a 3072x1024 master: the left side is outpainted with more deck and the right side with open sky, so the full height ships. Safe area and crop band: every head, hand, foot and Ouro sits between rows 150 and 900 and inside the left eleven-twelfths of the width, and every figure's feet are visible on the deck, with no object's edge at a figure's ankle. The cast spans the middle of the picture from about a sixth to about three-quarters of the way across. The gondola fills the left three-quarters; its curved bow ends about three-quarters of the way across, and the right quarter is calm open sky above a sea of soft cloud with far, soft snowy peaks. The upper left stays calm envelope glass and sky.

## Cast

### The person
- What: Ari, as a faceless adult person from the shared universe, standing at the bow and looking out at the horizon.
- Material: the head and neck are one smooth, softly frosted glass form, like a mannequin head cast in frosted glass, that reads as opaque-looking soft warm white with nothing visible inside it: the silhouette of a real adult man's head, a slightly elongated oval skull with a rounded back, a gently defined jaw curving to the chin, and a real neck about 0.4 of the head's width whose nape rises out of the collar. No hair, no ears, no nose, no facial features at all: the sides of the head are perfectly smooth, with no ear, bump, ridge or notch. A faint, even warm inner light, warm white turning soft amber at the core; never a lamp, bulb, egg or sphere; never saturated green.
- Build: natural adult proportions and an ordinary build: broad real shoulders, a head of natural adult size, a little larger than one-seventh of his standing height (about one-sixth-and-a-half) and about a third as wide as his shoulders, never small, a torso as long as a real adult's with the jacket hem at the hips, and arms and legs of natural length and thickness; never stretched tall and thin, never toy-like.
- Height: the tallest figure by far; the top of the helm robot's head reaches the person's belt.
- Outfit: a well-cut dark-brown leather flight jacket with a cream shearling collar, charcoal wool trousers, brown leather boots and brown leather mittens, and a deep moss-green wool scarf wrapped once at the neck with both ends streaming back toward the stern (left of frame) behind the shoulders, away from both arms.
- Expression: faceless; calm confidence shown by the body: upright, shoulders square and relaxed, chin level toward the horizon, weight settled evenly on both feet.
- Pose: standing at the bow rail, both feet flat on the deck planks just inside the rail.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs.
- Hands: thick, padded brown leather mittens like winter mittens, sized for an adult hand: each one smooth rounded pouch with exactly one thumb, never gloves, never separate fingers. Near (left) hand: tucked deep in his jacket pocket, out of sight, with a short closed brass spyglass held tucked under that arm against his side, both its ends showing in front of and behind the arm. Far (right) mitten: resting flat and closed on the brass rail cap in front of him, its one thumb along the rail.
- Facing: body faces the bow (right of frame), seen three-quarters from behind, back mostly to the camera; the head looks out over the bow.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the person's pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless translucent emerald glass with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: the smallest figure, about the size of a curled-up house cat: his whole coil, head included, is no taller than the person's head.
- Outfit: none; he is the pet, not a mascot.
- Expression: content and alert, eyes soft.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single small round "O" sitting directly on the brass rail cap a short step forward of the person's resting mitten, not touching it, the ring open at the top right: his head comes over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip rises just to the right of his head. A soft shadow under the coil on the brass.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view toward the horizon, so the camera sees one eye and the curve of his smile.

### The helm robot
- What: the helmsman agent, a small robot steering the airship.
- Material: smooth, seamless pale-jade glass lit softly from within, brass joints, a dark rounded visor, a round brass ear disc and a tiny brass antenna with an emerald bead.
- Height: the top of his head reaches the person's belt; the tallest agent.
- Outfit: plain round brass aviator goggles pushed up on his forehead on a plain smooth brown strap with no buckle, rivets or marks, and a short green flying scarf streaming back toward the stern.
- Expression: focused: his visor shows only two soft glowing oval eyes held level and steady; the visor below the eyes is plain dark glass with a smooth even gradient, no highlight, reflection or line.
- Pose: standing centred directly behind the ship's wheel, on its far side from the camera, facing the wheel and the camera, lined up exactly with the wheel: the centre of his visor is straight above the wheel's hub, the hub is exactly in front of the middle of his chest, his visor shows above the top of the rim, and his two legs show below the rim, one boot on each side of the wheel's pedestal at equal distances from it, both flat on the deck planks and both visible. Nothing of him sticks out past the wheel's left or right edge except his elbows.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: both mittens closed round the outer wooden rim of the wheel between handle pegs, one at ten o'clock and one at two o'clock, mirror images of each other, each a small smooth mitten no wider than his forearm with exactly one small thumb wrapped over the rim, both visibly attached to his arms.
- Facing: body and visor three-quarters toward the camera, looking through the wheel along the course; both eyes read.

### The ladder robot
- What: a small agent working aloft in the rigging, at the left of the cast.
- Material: smooth, seamless amber-orange glass lit softly from within, brass joints, a dark rounded visor.
- Height: about the helm robot's height, a little rounder, and drawn as large as the helm robot.
- Outfit: a plain red knit cap with a small pom-pom and a plain brown leather climbing harness.
- Expression: glad, shown by its posture: an easy, buoyant reach upward. Its visor shows only two small soft round glowing eyes; the rest of the visor is plain dark glass with a smooth even gradient and nothing below the eyes.
- Pose: climbing the bottom of a rope ladder at the left of the cast, both boots planted on the second wooden rung, a little above the deck, with the rung visible under its soles, its body hugging the ladder close.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: hugging the ladder: both arms reach forward round the ladder's two side ropes at shoulder height and its mittens close round the ropes on their far side, hidden behind the ropes and its own body; well clear of any knot, fitting or clamp.
- Facing: back three-quarters to the camera, facing the ladder; head turned over its shoulder three-quarters toward the camera so both eyes read.

### The valve robot
- What: a small agent keeping the engine trimmed.
- Material: smooth, seamless sea-blue glass lit softly from within, brass joints, a dark rounded visor, a plain smooth round top to its head, and its head sitting directly on its shoulders with no visible neck, gap or collar.
- Height: about the helm robot's height; kneeling, so its head is a little above the valve's handwheel.
- Outfit: a plain brown leather work apron.
- Expression: intent: its visor shows only two soft glowing eyes lowered toward the valve; the rest of the visor is plain dark glass with a smooth even gradient; its shoulders lean in over the work.
- Pose: kneeling on both knees on the open deck at lower left, right beside the valve, both knees and both boots visible on the planks.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs.
- Hands: both mittens closed on the rim of the valve's handwheel on opposite sides, turning it, each a small smooth mitten no wider than its forearm with exactly one small thumb wrapped over the rim.
- Facing: three-quarters toward the camera, looking down at the valve.

## Props
- Ship's wheel: a classic round wooden ship's wheel with a brass hub, eight spokes and eight handle pegs, on a short brass pedestal mid-left. The wheel's face points toward the camera, turned only slightly toward the bow, so we see its full round face with every spoke and the hub: it reads as a round wheel, a nearly circular ellipse, never seen edge-on and never as a thin vertical sliver; its lowest handle peg clears the deck. The helm robot is behind it, seen through the spokes.
- Spyglass: short, brass and closed, in the person's near mitten at the hip.
- Rope ladder: two side ropes with wooden rungs, rising from brass rings on the rail to the envelope's rim band; every rope ends in a plain brass ring at both ends.
- Valve: a ship's deck valve: a brass handwheel lying flat on top of an upright brass valve body whose round base flange is bolted flat to the deck planks; nothing else lies on the deck beside it.
- Envelope: a long glass envelope with brass ribs filling the top edge; the gondola hangs under it on ropes from brass fittings, every rope attached at both ends.
- Stern: a neat coil of rope lying flat on the deck and a plain brass lantern standing on the deck by the stern rail, both at the far left.

## Setting
A glass-and-brass airship gondola with one flat, open oak deck on a single level, enclosed on every side by a brass rail with brass posts and teal-glass lattice panels, sailing above a sea of soft white clouds with far, soft snowy peaks. The wind blows from the bow, so both scarves and the cap's pom-pom stream back toward the stern (left of frame).

## Light
Soft early-morning light comes from the right, with the sun already well up and far out of the frame to the right and above: no sun disc, no sunbeams, no gold streaks and no glow on the horizon anywhere in the picture. The sky is a clear, even soft morning blue all the way down to the cloud sea, only a little paler near the horizon, with no yellow, orange or white band; the soft white cloud sea is gently lit from the right with pale peach on its right-facing slopes. Warm rim light on the right edges of the figures, soft-edged shadows falling gently to the left, and a soft contact shadow under every foot, every knee and under Ouro. The person's inner light is soft and even, never a glow. A few soft highlights on the brass and the envelope glass, never sparkles.

## Palette
Soft morning blue sky with a hint of pale peach on the clouds, cloud white, brass gold and warm oak; warm white and soft amber for the person's glass, brown leather and moss green for his clothes; emerald for Ouro; jade, amber and sea-blue for the three agents; one red cap.

## Must not
- No sun disc, no sunbeams, no lens flare, no gold streaks on the deck and no bright yellow, orange or white horizon glow.
- No ears on the person, no hair and no face; no small, large, bulb, egg or sphere head and no missing neck; nothing visible inside the glass head.
- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No separate fingers, no gloves with fingers, no pointing gesture and no thumbs-up: mitten hands only, each with one thumb; no thumbless round ball hands.
- No edge-on ship's wheel and no robot standing beside the wheel instead of behind it.

generation.prompt:
# Chart room: ouroboros.bot home, "How I work"

## Story
Before the voyage, in the lamplit chart room of the airship, a faceless glass person and Loop, a small jade-glass agent, study the same big map spread on a plan chest, so Loop sets off knowing the route; Ouro lies curled on the chest beside Loop.

## Camera
40 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. We stand a few steps in front of the plan chest, square-on to its long front side, so its front edge runs perfectly level and parallel to the bottom of the frame. Eye level: the height of the person's chest, a little above the plan chest's top, so the chest top shows only as a shallow band and the map on it is seen at a low angle. One vanishing point, at the centre of the round porthole, which sits on the eye level; the chest's two short ends and the floorboards recede to it. Everything in the room shares this one eye level.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024; the chosen picture is widened on both sides and shipped as an 8:3 strip; the crop band is the whole height. The plan chest runs across the middle of the frame from about one tenth to nine tenths of the width, both of its short ends visible and clear; its top edge sits a little below the middle of the height and its plinth stands on the floor near the bottom edge. The person stands behind the chest left of centre, Loop stands on the chest top right of centre, Ouro lies on the chest top just right of Loop, and the round porthole is on the back wall between and behind them. The cast spans about half the width and most of the height. Nothing important in the top tenth or bottom tenth of the frame.

## Cast

### The person
- What: a faceless person from the shared universe, the one who decides where the voyage goes; the same kind of person as in the first reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless, lightly frosted glass with a soft warm inner light; the head is one soft, opaque-looking frosted form with nothing visible inside it.
- Build: natural adult proportions: the head is about one seventh of their standing height, a slightly elongated oval skull with a clear jaw line and chin, a real neck about four tenths of the head's width joining the shoulders; shoulders about three head-widths across. No ears, no face at all.
- Height: the tallest figure; standing behind the chest, its top edge reaches their hips, so we see them from the hips up.
- Outfit: an oatmeal knitted jumper with plain ribbed cuffs and a moss-green knitted scarf hanging still down their chest (indoors, no wind).
- Expression: faceless; calm and engaged, shown by the body: head tilted down toward the map and turned a little toward Loop, shoulders relaxed, leaning in a little.
- Pose: standing on the floor behind the long back side of the chest, left of centre, leaning slightly forward over the map.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder; legs hidden behind the chest.
- Hands: mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. Near (left) arm hangs relaxed at their side with its hand in their trouser pocket, below the chest's top edge and out of sight behind the chest. Far (right) mitten: resting flat and still on the map near its middle, palm down, a small smooth mitten no wider than the jumper's cuff, its one thumb lying flat along its side.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned a little to the right toward Loop; head tipped down to the map.

### Loop
- What: Loop, the agent who will sail the ship, a small robot.
- Material: smooth, seamless pale-jade glass lit softly from within, brass joints, a dark rounded visor, a round brass ear disc and a tiny brass antenna with an emerald bead.
- Height: standing on the chest top, his head is level with the person's shoulder.
- Outfit: brass aviator goggles pushed up on his forehead above the visor, and a small brown leather satchel on a wide strap across his body, its flap closed.
- Expression: absorbed and eager: on his visor, two calm glowing oval eyes looking down at the map; no mouth, and the visor below the eyes is a plain dark gradient.
- Pose: standing on both feet on the chest top right of the map, both feet flat on the wood and fully visible, leaning a little toward the map.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs.
- Hands: mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers. Near (left) mitten: wrapped round the wide satchel strap at his chest. Far (right) mitten: resting flat on the map's right edge, palm down.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned to the left toward the person and the map; head tipped down so both eyes read.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the person's pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless glossy emerald body with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat; his whole coil is about as tall as Loop's knee.
- Outfit: none.
- Expression: drowsy and content, eyes half-closed.
- Pose: one continuous tube coiled into a single round "O" lying on the chest top just right of Loop's feet, the ring open at the top right: his head rests over the top of the ring and his one short tail tip lies just to the right of his head. A soft contact shadow under the coil.
- Limbs: none: one head, one continuous body, one short tail tip.
- Hands: none.
- Facing: head in three-quarter view, turned toward Loop and the map.

## Props
- Plan chest: one long, low oak plan chest with wide shallow drawers and plain round brass knobs, a thick oak top with a softly rounded front edge, and a plain oak plinth standing flat on the floor; seen square-on, its front a flat rectangle, its two short ends visible and receding to the porthole.
- The map: one large sheet of cream paper lying flat on the chest top between the person and Loop, drawn with soft blue coastlines, pale green land and one faint dotted route; no letters, numbers or symbols.
- Compass: one small round brass compass lying flat on the map near its left edge.
- Lamp: one brass oil lamp with a clear glass chimney standing on its round brass base on the chest top at its left end, its flame lit warm.
- Rolled charts: two plain cream rolled charts lying on the chest top behind the map, parallel to the chest's front edge.

## Setting
The snug chart room inside the airship's gondola, moored before the voyage: a flat back wall of warm honey-oak panels running parallel to the frame, with one big round brass-rimmed porthole in its centre. Through the porthole, a soft dawn sky of peach and pale blue over a sea of soft rounded cloud blobs; the sun itself is out of frame. Warm wide oak floorboards in front of the chest. No side walls, no shelves, no pictures, nothing hung on the walls. Indoors, no wind: everything soft hangs still. Calm, warm and a little lived-in.

## Light
The oil lamp on the chest's left end is the key light, pooling warm gold on the map, the figures' fronts and the chest top. Soft cool-peach dawn light from the porthole rims the figures gently from behind. Shadows are few and soft-edged; no sun shafts, no window-bar stripes. A soft contact shadow under Loop's feet, under Ouro, under the lamp's base and under the person's resting mitten. Loop's body glows softly from within.

## Palette
Warm honey oak and brass gold, cream paper with soft blue, dawn peach and pale blue in the porthole; moss green for the scarf and oatmeal for the jumper; pale jade for Loop; emerald for Ouro; one brown leather satchel.

## Must not
- No third arm, no extra or missing limbs and no fused legs.
- No separate fingers on any hand: mitten hands, exactly one thumb, never separate fingers; no pointing gesture and no thumbs-up.
- No large, swollen or balloon hands: every mitten is small, no wider than its cuff or wrist.
- No ears, no face, no eyes, nose or mouth on the person; no clear bubble or bulb head.
- No mouth on Loop: no curved line, highlight or reflection under his eyes.
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere, including on the map, the compass and the drawers.
- No glowing trails or lines of light.
- No electronics of any age: brass instruments and paper only.
- No hanging lamp, no chains, no shelves, no framed pictures, no side walls, no ceiling beams.
- No table or chest seen at an angle: the chest front stays level and square-on.
- No tiles, cells or facets on the glass bodies.
- No rustic, cottage or storybook styling; no cartoon meadow; no giant Ouro: he is never taller than Loop's knee.
- No second agent, no second person and no second snake.
- No figure facing the camera full on.
- No image fades or vignettes.

## Output
Generated whole at 1536x1024, quality high. The chosen picture is widened on both sides and shipped as a 1536x576 header and as phone and social crops centred on the cast. The night twin is a relight of the chosen picture: the same frame, figures and poses by the oil lamp's warm light, with a moonlit night sky in the porthole.

## References
1. The first image: the current ouroboros.bot airship master's centre, for the render quality, light, materials, the look of the glass person's head and of Loop only. Its deck, setting and composition are not to be copied.
2. The second image: `brand/ouro.png`, for Ouro's exact face and coil.

# The line: ouroboros.bot home, "Software factories can learn from real ones"

## Story
In the airship's own warm, sunlit workshop, three small glass agents build little airships along one long oak bench, each steadying its own ship with both mittens, while a faceless glass person stands at the bench's left end with both hands in the apron pockets, timing the line by the brass pocket watch hanging on its chain at the hip, and Ouro, their pet snake, watches from the bench's right end.

## Camera
40 mm lens, premium animated-film render, natural film colour. Eye level: just a little above the bench's top, as if we sit on a low stool a few steps in front of the bench, so the bench top shows only as a thin, shallow sliver of its top surface above its front edge. There is exactly one eye level for the whole room: the bench top, the floorboards and the cloud horizon seen through the doorway all share it. The bench is seen square-on: its long front edge runs straight across the frame, parallel to the bottom of the picture. One vanishing point, at the centre of the picture on that eye level, where the floorboards converge. The back wall is flat and parallel to the picture and fills the whole width behind the cast; no side walls show. Above the eye level we see only the undersides of things, never their tops.

## Composition
Generated at 1536x1024; the chosen picture is widened on both sides to an 8:3 strip, so the crop band is the whole height, and the cast sits close together along the bench across the middle half of the width and fills most of its height. Left to right: the person standing just in front of and left of the bench's left end; the amber agent behind the bench's left part; the sea-blue agent behind the bench's middle, in front of the open doorway; Loop behind the bench's right part; Ouro on the bench's right end. Each agent stands behind its own little airship, which rests in an oak cradle on the bench in front of it. Safe area: the left quarter and the right quarter are calm back wall, each with one brass wall lamp. Nothing important in the top or bottom fifth of the frame.

## Cast

### The person
- What: a faceless adult person from the shared universe, the one who measures the work.
- Material: a matte frosted glass head and neck, like softly sandblasted glass, with a soft, even warm inner light, warm white turning soft gold at the core and no glossy highlights and no bright rim or edge glow; the head reads as one soft, opaque-looking frosted form with nothing visible inside it; a real adult head: a slightly elongated oval skull with a rounded back, a clear jaw line and a natural neck about four tenths of the head's width joining the shoulders; no ears; no face at all: no eyes, nose, brow, mouth or smile; never a clear bubble or bulb, never milky white or saturated green.
- Build: natural adult proportions and an ordinary build: real shoulders, a head about one-seventh of the standing height, never larger, a normal torso, arms and legs of natural length and thickness; never stretched tall and thin, never toy-like.
- Height: the tallest figure; the bench top is at the person's hip.
- Outfit: a soft cream shirt with a low open collar so the whole neck shows, a moss-green knitted scarf looped once loosely around the neck with both ends hanging still down the chest, a sand-coloured canvas work apron from chest to knee with two large, clearly drawn front pockets, charcoal trousers and brown leather boots.
- Expression: faceless; attentive and calm, shown by the body: head turned toward the line of agents, shoulders easy.
- Pose: standing on the floorboards just in front of and left of the bench's left end, a step clear of it, both boots flat on the floor and fully visible, weight on one leg.
- Limbs: exactly two arms, each from its own shoulder, and two legs.
- Hands: smooth glass mitten hands, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers; both hands are pushed deep into the apron's two front pockets, so no hand shows: each shirt cuff goes straight into a clearly drawn pocket opening.
- Facing: body three-quarters toward the camera, turned to the right of frame toward the agents; head turned toward the agents.

### The amber agent
- What: a small agent building the first little airship.
- Material: smooth, seamless amber-orange glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor.
- Height: standing behind the bench, the top of its head reaches the person's shoulder; the bench top is at its waist.
- Outfit: a plain red knit cap with a small pom-pom.
- Expression: content: on its visor, two soft glowing oval eyes lowered toward its airship; no mouth and no line, curve, reflection or highlight under the eyes; the visor below the eyes is a plain dark gradient.
- Pose: standing behind the bench's left part, chest a little forward over its airship.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs; its legs are hidden behind the bench.
- Hands: small round mittens, each no wider than its forearm, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers; both mittens rest flat and still on the near side of its airship's big round envelope, one toward each end, steadying it.
- Facing: body square to the camera, head tilted down toward its airship so both eyes read.

### The sea-blue agent
- What: a small agent building the second little airship.
- Material: smooth, seamless sea-blue glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor and a plain smooth round top to its head.
- Height: the same as the amber agent; the bench top is at its waist.
- Outfit: a plain brown leather work apron.
- Expression: intent: two soft glowing oval eyes lowered toward its airship; the visor below the eyes is a plain dark gradient.
- Pose: standing behind the middle of the bench, in front of the open doorway.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs; its legs are hidden behind the bench.
- Hands: small round mittens, each no wider than its forearm, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers; both mittens rest flat and still on the near side of its airship's big round envelope, one toward each end.
- Facing: body square to the camera, head tilted down toward its airship so both eyes read.

### Loop
- What: Loop, the pale-jade helm agent from the airship, building the third little airship.
- Material: smooth, seamless pale-jade glass lit softly from within, satin brass joints, a dark rounded visor and a tiny brass antenna with an emerald bead.
- Height: the same as the other agents; the bench top is at his waist.
- Outfit: plain round brass aviator goggles pushed up on his forehead on a plain smooth brown strap with no buckle, rivets or marks.
- Expression: pleased: two soft glowing oval eyes, gently arched, lowered toward his airship; the visor below the eyes is a plain dark gradient.
- Pose: standing behind the bench's right part.
- Limbs: exactly two arms and two legs; his legs are hidden behind the bench.
- Hands: small round mittens, each no wider than his forearm, each with exactly one small thumb, never separate fingers; both mittens rest flat and still on the near side of his airship's big round envelope, one toward each end.
- Facing: body square to the camera, head tilted down toward his airship so both eyes read.

### Ouro
- What: Ouro, the pet snake, exactly as in the second reference image.
- Material: smooth, seamless glossy emerald body with a gentle inner glow and a pale jade belly; the face, eyes and smile of the second reference image.
- Height: about the size of a curled-up house cat; his whole coil is about as tall as an agent's head, much smaller than any agent.
- Outfit: none; he is the pet, not a mascot.

Low warm evening sun from the left is the key light, catching the brass and the envelope's glass; the gondola's windows glow warm from inside. Evening gold and peach sky fading to soft blue, golden meadow, brass gold, warm oak; pale jade for Loop, emerald for Ouro; the envelope's glass catching gold.
